items.title: Jasper Taylor Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: I only played, uh, washboard with, uh, James O'Brien's trio, washboard trio.

ctx.x: Yeah. Uh, did you play washboard on any of that date, or either one of those? No, no, no.
I only played, uh, washboard with, uh, James O'Brien's trio, washboard trio.
When did you start with those washboards? After you hit Chicago, that kind of music? No. Or have you ever played that in the minstrel days, too, or?
